# AI OS Installer

> Conversational AI-guided Linux installer — describe what you want, the AI handles the rest.

## What it does

AI OS Installer replaces the traditional Linux installation wizard with a conversation.
Instead of navigating menus, answering cryptic questions about partitioning or locales,
or reading documentation, you describe your use case in plain language and the AI
configures and installs Ubuntu 24.04 LTS for you.

## Who it is for

- Developers setting up a new Linux workstation
- DevOps engineers automating lab or VM provisioning
- Linux beginners intimidated by traditional installers
- Anyone who wants a fully configured, opinionated Ubuntu setup without manual steps

## How to use it

```bash
docker run -it --privileged \
  -e ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=<your-key> \
  ghcr.io/gauthierbraillon/ai-os-installer:latest
```

Then just talk to it:

```
AI: Hi! What will you mainly use this Linux system for?
You: Web development and some gaming
AI: Got it. I'll set up Node, Docker, VS Code, Steam, and configure GPU drivers.
    Simple setup or detailed customization?
You: Simple
AI: Installing now...
```

## Technology

- Language: Go 1.22
- AI: Claude API (Anthropic) — conversational requirement gathering and configuration
- Installation target: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS
- VM backend: QEMU
- Distribution: Docker container (no installation required to run the installer itself)

## Key capabilities

- Natural language requirement gathering
- Automatic package selection based on use case (web dev, gaming, data science, etc.)
- Generates Ubuntu preseed / cloud-init config from conversation
- Runs unattended installation inside a QEMU VM
- Post-install configuration (packages, shell, dotfiles)

## Architecture

```
User Terminal
     ↓
Conversation Manager  (collects requirements, manages state)
     ↓
AI Engine             (Claude API, prompt engineering, response parsing)
     ↓
Config Generator      (conversation → install config JSON)
     ↓
Install Executor      (runs installation in VM via QEMU)
```
